name: quilt-chrono
description: Time as a first-class dimension of the quilt: an append-only reading/writing ledger over a tiny reactive cell core, with projections (stateAt, diff, flowMap, SVG) and rewind; signed custody via organ-checkpoint-exact seals (src/seal.js).

schemas.chain-sidecar: organ receipt chain (one link per chrono entry, op = the entry)
schemas.seal: quilt.organ.checkpoint v1 (HMAC-SHA256), byte-exact with quilt-jev-toolkit organ v2
